params.name: page
params.description: Consolidated pagination parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[size], page[number]

items.docs:
Send a fax. Files have size limits and page count limit validations. If a file is bigger than 50MB or has more than 350 pages it will fail with `file_size_limit_exceeded` and `page_count_limit_exceeded` respectively. 

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `fax.queued`
- `fax.media.processed`
- `fax.sending.started`
- `fax.delivered`
- `fax.failed`
